These gloves can also be a drop from Dagannoths in the Waterbirth Dungeon and they can also be obtained from Managing Miscellania by putting workers in the fishing area. Yrsa is a fashion designer and runs Yrsa's Accoutrements and a makeover shop. She plays a role in Sigmund the Merchant's task in The Fremennik Trials quest.
